name: IFIR
description: IFIR is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating instruction-following in expert-domain information retrieval across finance, law, healthcare, and science literature. It contains 2,426 examples with varying instruction complexity to assess models' ability to follow domain-specific retrieval instructions.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark for expert-domain retrieval instruction following that is useful for evaluating retrieval-oriented LLMs, but not yet broadly established as a standard benchmark.
notes: First benchmark focusing on instruction-following IR in expert domains; uses a novel LLM-based evaluation method.
